title: Run the Dang Ball!
text:
This is a story about running the ball. We are seeing if running the ball is needed to win game


Code
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = fbs, aes(x = rush_ypg, y = wins), color = "steelblue", alpha = .6) +
  geom_smooth(data = fbs, aes(x = rush_ypg, y = wins), method = "lm", color = "firebrick") +
  geom_point(data = standouts, aes(x = rush_ypg, y = wins), color = "navy", size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = standouts, aes(x = rush_ypg, y = wins, label = team)) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 240, y = 1, label = "Correlation (r) = 0.45")) +
  labs(
    title = "Rushing Yards per Game vs. Wins (2025 FBS Season)",
    x = "Rushing Yards per Game",
    y = "Wins"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()











Code
ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = record_avg,
           aes(x = reorder(record_group, avg_rush_ypg),
               weight = avg_rush_ypg, fill = record_group)) +
  geom_text(data = record_avg,
            aes(x = reorder(record_group, avg_rush_ypg),
                y = avg_rush_ypg + 12, label = round(avg_rush_ypg, 1))) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 220)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Elite (10+ wins)" = "forestgreen",
                               "Middle (.500 or better, under 10 wins)" = "gray",
                               "Losing (more losses than wins)" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Rushing Yards per Game by Team Record (2025 FBS)",
    x = "Team Record Category",
    y = "Average Rushing Yards per Game"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")











Code
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = middle, aes(x = rush_ypg, y = def_ypg_allowed, size = wins),
             color = "gray", alpha = .7) +
  geom_point(data = losing, aes(x = rush_ypg, y = def_ypg_allowed, size = wins),
             color = "firebrick", alpha = .7) +
  geom_point(data = elite, aes(x = rush_ypg, y = def_ypg_allowed, size = wins),
             color = "forestgreen", alpha = .7) +
  geom_text_repel(data = standouts, aes(x = rush_ypg, y = def_ypg_allowed, label = team)) +
  scale_size(range = c(3, 8)) +
  labs(
    title = "Rushing Offense vs. Defense (2025 FBS Season)",
    subtitle = "Bubble size = total wins. Green = elite (10+ wins), gray = middle, red = losing record",
    x = "Rushing Yards per Game",
    y = "Total Yards Allowed per Game"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
